apps.localizedDescription: Native SwiftUI + WKWebView operator browser for iPhone. v0.5 PEAK adds an adaptive Agent Dock and draggable persisted Agent Ball, single Mission Control workspace, run-bound navigation, centralized redaction, secure local persistence, and platform-neutral Engagement Profiles for authorized research.
